summary: The typed, allowlisted, size-capped, traced read-only tool registry a model reaches the world through, with room_by_id as its first tool

coordination.notes: room_by_id reads a MapZone the caller supplies - the same shape compileWorldSnapshot reads - rather than importing mapData.ts. Two reasons pointing the same way: mapData.ts resolves zones through import.meta.glob, which only Vite can do, so importing it would make this module untestable outside the app; and a tool layer that reaches into a canonical store on its own has whatever scope it can see rather than the scope it was given. No new parser: exits are the cartographer's own move/destination pairs, paired by index exactly as toZoneRoom writes them, with a null rather than a guess where one side is absent.
coordination.deviations: The plan's verify asks for `a 1 MB fixture result → truncated flag`; docs/LOCAL_AI_BACKGROUND_WORKER.md section 16 asks for a tool that would exceed its ceiling to fail rather than truncate. Both are implemented, split by shape: an array is shortened with truncated:true because a prefix of an array is still a true partial answer, and anything else is refused because half an object is not a smaller object, it is a wrong one. capResult is exported because the shortening branch is otherwise unreachable through any tool that returns an object, and a branch nobody can execute on purpose is a branch nobody can prove.
